scope: Future source-backed regression requirements; no planner qualification or policy change

cases.required_evidence: Official allowed/forbidden entry and exit ends, direction and start-area restrictions.
cases.positive_case: Complete arrival/task/withdrawal/reentry for every assigned box using explicitly allowed ends.
cases.negative_case: Reject prohibited end, wrong direction or forbidden start-area traversal even when collision-free.
cases.affected_contract: Pit entry/exit policy; historical north hypothesis retained separately.

cases.required_evidence: Authoritative boundary edges, projected envelope and permitted internal-line crossing.
cases.positive_case: Full specified chassis/tire/mechanism envelope stays in each required area.
cases.negative_case: Reject an envelope crossing a forbidden edge although its center remains inside; exercise boundary contact separately.
cases.affected_contract: Phase containment and swept envelope; no center-only substitution.

cases.required_evidence: Finish-line endpoints/direction, ordered lap progress and treatment of pit/reverse/repeated crossings.
cases.positive_case: Three valid laps with pit stop after lap 1 or 2; timing and final state evaluated independently.
cases.negative_case: No duplicate lap credit for reverse/repeated/pit crossings or incomplete circuit.
cases.affected_contract: Official lap state machine replacing provisional gates only after review.

cases.required_evidence: Three-vehicle lane/quadrant allocation, permitted rotations and full-footprint versus reference-point containment.
cases.positive_case: Validate admissible three-vehicle placements at region edges and allowed orientations.
cases.negative_case: Reject forbidden allocation, orientation or containment breach; do not equate independent single blockers with match coverage.

cases.required_evidence: Organizer-qualified model/substitution list and maximum length, width including wheels, height and uncertainty.
cases.positive_case: Use versioned conservative installed envelopes for every approved vehicle type.
cases.negative_case: Reject package dimensions, unidentified toy photos or missing protrusions as qualifying footprint evidence.

cases.required_evidence: Dimensioned datum faces/endpoints and interpretation of G02 for built geometry and placement.
cases.positive_case: Check justified tolerance extremes, divider endpoints and tower projections without shrinking uncertainty.
cases.negative_case: Reject a nominal-only clearance claim or arbitrary correlated shifts as exhaustive G02 coverage.
cases.affected_contract: Field datums and explicit bounded uncertainty model.

cases.required_evidence: Official exchange completion, tire retention, final parking metric and scoring observation time.
cases.positive_case: Score authorized exchange independently of final parking; evaluate parking below, at and above 75% using confirmed metric.
cases.negative_case: Do not award >75% at exactly 75%; reject wrong tire/box/retention event as specified and late scoring.
cases.affected_contract: Task events, docking reach, final containment and finish timing.
